description: Digital delivery state for an order. Written by the app under $app.digital_downloads.

access_token.description: Secret in the order's downloads link. Replacing it makes the old link stop working

downloads_url.description: The order's downloads page. Readable by the customer who placed the order

access_status.description: granted once the buyer has access, revoked after a cancellation, refund or admin action

date_notified.description: When the downloads email was last sent

keys_missing.description: License keys the order is still owed because a key pool ran out
